plan.title: Decompose src/dashboard/server/routes/agents.ts (4071 lines) into focused modules
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: src/dashboard/server/routes/agents.ts is a 4071-line god file on the pipeline hot path (start-agent / spawn / live-control). It bundles ~40 Effect HttpRouter route handlers plus ~600 lines of shared helpers in one file, far above the 1000-line file-size ceiling (baselined shrink-only).
narratives.Proposal: Extract cohesive route clusters into a sibling directory src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/*.ts, each under 1000 lines, leaving routes/agents.ts as a thin barrel that imports each route Layer, composes agentsRouteLayer via Layer.mergeAll, and re-exports every symbol it currently exports. Pure move + re-export (established repo pattern, see B3-agents-queries-extract.md). The spawn handler postAgentsRoute (~1094 lines) is the only file that exceeds the ceiling alone; its self-contained container-orchestration and remote-spawn inner blocks are extracted into agents/spawn-helpers.ts as parameterized, behavior-preserving functions. Seams are serialized (each edits the barrel) and each is independently green.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No logic change, renamed export, or changed HTTP behavior — byte-identical behavior.
- Do NOT decompose src/lib/agents.ts (a different file) or any other route file.
- Do NOT refactor the spawn handler's logic — only physically relocate its self-contained inner blocks with identical statement order.
- Do NOT change the Layer.mergeAll route set — all 41 routes stay composed.
- Do NOT edit importers or tests (the barrel re-export keeps them resolving) unless a specific move demonstrably breaks a test.
- Do NOT introduce any new explicit `any`; do NOT use execSync; async tmux only.

autoDecisions.summary: Sibling agents/ directory + barrel re-export at routes/agents.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the repo's own established B3/agents-decomp move+re-export pattern; zero call-site churn and all co-located tests import via the barrel.

autoDecisions.summary: Spawn handler is split (not byte-moved): container-orchestration + remote-spawn inner blocks extracted into agents/spawn-helpers.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: postAgentsRoute (~1094 lines) exceeds the 1000 ceiling alone; relocating only top-level declarations cannot fix it. This is the single sanctioned deviation from pure move, logic preserved, deep-inspected.

autoDecisions.summary: Seams serialized (readiness: sequential, linear blocks chain).
autoDecisions.rationale: Every seam edits the barrel routes/agents.ts; parallel execution would conflict. Consistent with the supervised-handoff objection on this hot-path pipeline machinery.
All co-located __tests__/agents-*.test.ts import via the barrel '../agents.js'; the re-export keeps them green. Repoint only if a move demonstrably breaks a test.

autoDecisions.summary: Each shrinking seam runs `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update` and adds any-carrying new modules to eslint-any-allowlist.json.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file-size guard prints this exact instruction on stale baseline; --update only lowers/drops. The A1 ratchet requires new files carrying moved `any` to be allowlisted.
